proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: over the algebraic closure, the derivative of [p] is multiplication by p on the tangent space, hence everywhere zero, so [p]^* on function fields kills Omega; taking a p-basis t_1, ..., t_g of k(A), each [p]^*(t_i) is a pth power, producing the subextension with presentation x_i^p = t_i and a factorization of [p] over an affine open through a finite locally free morphism pi_1 over a universal homeomorphism pi_2 of degree p^g; since [p] has degree p^{2g}, pi_1 has degree p^g, so fibres have at most p^g points, and translation-invariance makes this uniform over all base points (source lines 2075-2117)

standard_prerequisites.use: Derivative of [p] is multiplication by p on tangent space, hence zero.

core_obligations: Vanishing derivative (proof lines 2077-2088): over k-bar, the derivative of [p] is multiplication by p on T_{A/k,e} (0BF5), zero in characteristic p; translation-invariance makes it everywhere zero, so [p]^* kills Omega_{k(A)/k} (compare 0BFH).

Factorization (proof lines 2089-2110): choose a p-basis t_1, ..., t_g (07P1, 07P2); each [p]^*(t_i) is a pth power (031W), giving the subextension k(A)[x_1, ..., x_g]/(x_i^p - t_i) inside [p]^*k(A); after shrinking to an affine U one gets the displayed factorization [p]^{-1}(U) -> Spec(O(U)[x_1, ..., x_g]/(x_i^p - t_i)) -> U, whose middle extension pi_1 is finite free on the monomials in the x_i (visible from the presentation, as the parenthetical notes).

Degree count (proof lines 2110-2117): [p] has degree p^{2g} (0BFG) and pi_2 is a universal homeomorphism of degree p^g, so pi_1 has degree p^g and the fibres of [p]^{-1}(U) -> U are the fibres of pi_1, of size at most p^g; group-scheme homogeneity makes the bound uniform in the base point.
proof_roadmap: Show the derivative of [p] is everywhere zero (proof lines 2077-2088).
Build the p-basis factorization of [p] through a finite free middle morphism (proof lines 2089-2110).
Split degrees and count fibres; uniformize by translation (proof lines 2110-2117).
